title: plugin-audit's recordLabel guesses from a fixed key list instead of the ADR-0079 resolver, so an object titled by company_name shows its record id on every activity row
body:
## Source

objectstack-ai/cloud acceptance run on 2026-10-05 (cloud main `4b38cd28` · objectstack main `088428fb` · objectui main `76993f8e`). A new free user had the AI build a 客户 object. Its fields are `company_name / phone / status`; it has no `name` field and declares no `nameField`. Every row on the record's discussion feed reads:

```
Created 客户 "RZGAEnis7ms__pjv"
Updated 客户 "RZGAEnis7ms__pjv"
```

`sys_activity.record_label` holds the record id for all 15 rows of that object. The record page header shows 「宁波海晟进出口有限公司」 for the same record, because the renderer resolves the title through ADR-0079.

(The English verb is a separate cause: the workspace has no default locale. That half is tracked on the cloud side, not here.)

## Mechanism

`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts:299` `recordLabel()` guesses the label from a fixed list of keys and falls back to the id:

```ts
const candidates = ['name', 'subject', 'title', 'full_name', 'label', 'first_name', 'company', 'email'];
```

`company_name` is not in that list. The same file already imports `resolveDisplayField` (line 28) and uses it for referenced-record titles (~line 1303). So the activity label is a second display-name dialect beside the ADR-0079 resolver that every renderer uses.

Measured against the spec on objectstack main `088428fb`:

- `resolveDisplayField({ fields: { company_name, phone, status } })` → `company_name`
- `resolveDisplayField({ fields: { visit_title, visit_date, visit_summary, customer } })` → `visit_title`

## Fix direction

Resolve the label through `resolveDisplayField(objectDef)`, and keep the id only as the floor when that resolves nothing or the value is empty. Keep the `field` answer that #21081's read-side gating relies on: it becomes the resolved field.

## Acceptance

1. A record of an object titled only by `company_name` gets `record_label` = the company name, and `field` = `company_name`.
2. Objects that have `name` / `title` / `subject` are labelled exactly as today.
3. An object whose resolved title value is empty still falls back to the id.
4. #21081's masking still holds: a reader who is not served the resolved field does not see the label.
